THINKING, FAST AND SLOW
in the effort that is required for its
completion. Effort is mobilized when it
is needed. The same is true of the
mental and the physical.
A rule of the body applies to the mind.
the reading line · a third down
A general law of least effort applies to
cognitive as well as physical exertion.
The law asserts that if there are several
ways of achieving the same goal, people
will eventually gravitate to the least
demanding course of action.
you are here: under the words, fades in, held, then gone
